def transform(grid):
    G=tuple(map(tuple,grid)); bg=mostcolor(G)
    objs=sorted(objects(G,T,F,T), key=len, reverse=True)
    from collections import Counter
    sizes=Counter(len(o) for o in objs)
    S=max(s for s,c in sizes.items() if c>=2)
    tied=[o for o in objs if len(o)==S]
    objcount=Counter(color(o) for o in objs)
    src=min(tied, key=lambda o: objcount[color(o)])
    singles={c:sum(len(o) for o in objs if color(o)==c) for c in set(map(color,objs)) if objcount[c]==1}
    tgt=max((c for c in singles if c!=color(src)), key=lambda c: singles[c])
    return [list(r) for r in fill(G,tgt,toindices(src))]

def center_dist(o, h, w):
    return min(abs(i-(h-1)/2)+abs(j-(w-1)/2) for i,j in toindices(o))
for n in range(1,6):
    gi, go = G[f'Demo pair {n} input'], G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    Gt=tuple(map(tuple,gi)); Go=tuple(map(tuple,go))
    ch=[(i,j,Gt[i][j],Go[i][j]) for i in range(len(Gt)) for j in range(len(Gt[0])) if Gt[i][j]!=Go[i][j]]
    h,w=len(Gt),len(Gt[0])
    objs=objects(Gt,T,T,T)
    sc=ch[0][2]; tc=ch[0][3]
    src=[o for o in objs if color(o)==sc and contained((ch[0][0],ch[0][1]),toindices(o))][0]
    twins=[o for o in objs if o!=src and canon2(o)==canon2(src)]
    pair=sorted([src]+twins,key=lambda o: center_dist(o,h,w))
    # group sizes: all congruent groups
    from collections import defaultdict
    gg=defaultdict(list)
    for o in objs: gg[canon2(o)].append(o)
    gsize=max(len(v) and len(v[0]) for v in gg.values() if len(v)>1)
    largest=[v for v in gg.values() if len(v)>1 and len(v[0])==gsize]
    # target: largest singleton object color excluding pair colors
    pc={color(o) for o in pair}
    pc2={color(x) for v in largest for x in v}
    sing=[o for o in objs if sum(1 for x in objs if color(x)==color(o))==1 and color(o) not in pc2]
    tgt=max(sing,key=lambda o:size(o)) if sing else None
    print(n,'h,w',h,w,'changed',ch[0][2],'->',tc,'| pair colors',pc2,'largest grp',len(largest[0]),'| src closest-to-center?',src is pair[0],'| tgt pred',color(tgt) if tgt else None,'ok',tgt and color(tgt)==tc, [ (color(o),size(o),round(center_dist(o,h,w),1)) for o in pair], 'nsing',len(sing))

def demo_analysis(n):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    Gi=tuple(map(tuple,gi)); Go=tuple(map(tuple,go))
    H,W=len(Gi),len(Gi[0])
    ch=[(i,j,Gi[i][j],Go[i][j]) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if Gi[i][j]!=Go[i][j]]
    sc,tc=ch[0][2],ch[0][3]
    objs=objects(Gi,T,T,T)
    src=[o for o in objs if color(o)==sc and contained((ch[0][0],ch[0][1]),toindices(o))][0]
    others=[o for o in objs if o!=src]
    return Gi,Go,H,W,ch,sc,tc,objs,src,others

for n in range(1,7):
    Gi,Go,H,W,ch,sc,tc,objs,src,others=demo_analysis(n)
    # congruent groups
    gg=defaultdict(list)
    for o in objs: gg[canon2(o)].append(o)
    srcgrp=[v for v in gg.values() if src in v][0]
    grpinfo=[(len(v), size(v[0]), [color(o) for o in v]) for v in gg.values() if len(v)>1]
    twins=[o for o in srcgrp if o!=src]
    # candidate target rules
    excl=set(color(o) for o in srcgrp)
    sing=[o for o in others if sum(1 for x in others+[] if color(x)==color(o))==1 or True]
    from collections import Counter as Ct
    cc=Ct(color(o) for o in objs)
    singleton_objs=[o for o in objs if cc[color(o)]==1 and color(o) not in excl]
    ls=max(singleton_objs,key=size,default=None)
    # nearest to twin
    twin=twins[0] if twins else None
    near=None
    if twin is not None:
        cands=[o for o in objs if o not in srcgrp]
        near=min(cands,key=lambda o: cdist(twin,o))
    print(f'D{n}: chg {sc}->{tc} cells={size(src)} ul={ulcorner(toindices(src))} | grp members={len(srcgrp)} sizes={[size(o) for o in srcgrp]} allgrps={grpinfo}')
    print(f'   twin={color(twin) if twin else None}, nearest-to-twin={color(near) if near else None} d={cdist(twin,near) if near else None}, largest-singleton={color(ls) if ls else None} sz={size(ls) if ls else None}, tgt-obj-in-same-grp={tc in [color(o) for o in srcgrp]}')

def rule(n):
    Gi,Go,H,W,ch,sc,tc,objs,src,others=demo_analysis(n)
    gg=defaultdict(list)
    for o in objs: gg[canon2(o)].append(o)
    multis={k:v for k,v in gg.items() if len(v)>1}
    members=[o for v in multis.values() for o in v]
    singles=[o for o in objs if all(o not in v for v in multis.values())]
    if not singles or not members: return None
    tgt_big=max(singles,key=lambda o:size(o))
    src_p=min(members,key=lambda o:cdist(o,tgt_big))
    # predicted target: nearest singleton to the twin (other members of src_p's group)
    grp=[o for o in members if canon2(o)==canon2(src_p)]
    twin=[o for o in grp if o!=src_p]
    cands=sorted(singles,key=lambda o:cdist(o,twin[0]) if twin else INF)
    pred_t=color(cands[0]) if cands else None
    ok_src = color(src_p)==sc and size(src_p)==size(src) and cdist(src_p,src)<=1.0 or src_p==src or toindices(src_p)==toindices(src)
    return dict(n=n, ok_src=bool(ok_src), pred_tgt=pred_t, actual_tgt=tc,
                srcinfo=(color(src_p),size(src_p)), actual_src=(sc,size(src)))
for n in range(1,8):
    r=rule(n); print(r)

def demo_analysis(n):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    Gi=tuple(map(tuple,gi)); Go=tuple(map(tuple,go))
    H,W=len(Gi),len(Gi[0])

    objs=objects(Gi,T,T,T)
    src=[o for o in objs if color(o)==sc and contained((ch[0][0],ch[0][1]),toindices(o))][0]
    others=[o for o in objs if o!=src]
    return Gi,Go,H,W,ch,sc,tc,objs,src,others
